summary: Senior Manager Quantitative Analytics candidate with ~7 years in independent model validation, model governance, and quantitative analytics. Holds delegated sign-off authority at Moody's Analytics on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM model outputs for institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement, and sits on the model governance committee that helps set benchmarking, documentation, and model-performance standards for client-delivered analytics. Advanced Python (pandas, NumPy, SciPy) and working SQL (PostgreSQL); builds validation tooling and agentic-AI review workflows that cut cycle time 30-40%. CFA charterholder, dual MSc.
core_skills: Stochastic Modelling, Monte Carlo & Scenario Analysis
Agentic AI Development Workflows (Claude Code, Cursor)

sections.heading: Independent Validation & Technical Review
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM model outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions before production release.
Tests conceptual soundness and economic defensibility of model assumptions, holding releases and escalating outputs lacking mathematical support to product and development owners for resolution.
Validates derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, checking sensitivity consistency and stability at portfolio-level aggregates.
Reviews aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream ALM and capital processes.

sections.heading: Model Governance, Framework & Reporting
bullets: Serves on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, benchmarking and documentation standards, and model performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.
Operates within a formal Model Risk Management and governance framework, building validation and documentation standards consistent with SR 11-7 and OSFI E-23 expectations.
Acts as escalation contact for client-critical analytical issues and prepares analytical summaries translating quantitative outputs into committee-ready narratives for clients' Heads of Risk.

sections.heading: Quantitative Development, Python & Automation
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenario analysis across ALM horizons.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python (pandas, NumPy, SciPy) analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection, reducing development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM) and PFaroe PM analytics platforms, validating model outputs post-deployment.
Translated client investment-team requirements into structured requests for product owners and development teams, completing migration of all assigned accounts off the legacy Calypso platform.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurers, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Advised actuarial, IT, finance, and program-management functions on standards adoption; contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and near-optimal frontier analysis testing the robustness of allocation recommendations.

Led the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger on a team of three, developing and validating the model capturing all Funding Policy dynamics across duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlays.
Presented study findings and stress-test results to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
